notes.title: Merch Shop Added!
notes.content:
[h2][b][u]Merch Shop Added![/u][/b][/h2]

You can now visit the official [url=https://roxiano.com]Roxiano merch shop[/url] for things like art books and stickers! More things will be added soon to the shop. In addition, you may join the [url=https://www.patreon.com/roxiano]Patreon[/url] for monthly coupons and exclusive content.

[b]Game Update[/b]

-Fixed mac issues for some players.
-Previous update is now in effect for everyone.

notes.title: Hotel Tutwin is Now Updated to v2.1
notes.content:
What's New:

[h1]Backlog![/h1]
-Backlog button above message window
-Designed to match the themes of other menus

[h1]Share Buttons and More[/h1]
-When you reach an ending, you may share to Twitter.
-When you reach a major ending, you may visit the Roxiano Creations Patreon for more.

[h1]Misc. Fixes[/h1]
-Changed name errors. Aniko's name was sometimes appearing as Anelle. If you've read the art book, you would know why that mistake may have occurred.

notes.title: Announcing the Art Book!!
notes.content:
First off, I want to thank you all for playing the game! Your lovely reviews make my day every single day and you're the reason I keep going with my game development and other projects. Now, I'm announcing something really exciting!

I've finally released the Hotel Tutwin Art Book this month! It includes character sketches, CG Art processes and deleted content. This is a major announcement and there will be more to come!

Physical merchandise is patron-exclusive, so hop on over and check it out on [url=https://www.patreon.com/roxiano]Patreon[/url] !
